history.summary: A newish (2024 TOP) 807 sqft 2BR at $1,610 psf in a large 1,410-unit Kovan development, 910m from the future Hougang CRL station. After stripping developer-pricing inflation the system marks bias-adjusted appreciation at just 2.2%/yr (resale-only 4.9%), and the unit is 910m from MRT with reported marble-flooring defects. Large liquid project but modest growth runway and a soft MRT link — a balanced Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: Positives: a large, modern 1,410-unit project (deep liquidity, full facilities), $1.3M entry in the liquid band, the 80m lagoon/condo-in-a-park product, and proximity to the future Hougang CRL interchange. But the new-launch bias is real — the system's bias-adjusted appreciation is only 2.2%/yr versus a 4.9% resale-only figure, and as a 2024-TOP project recent buyers paid full developer pricing, leaving limited near-term upside on a 5-7 year hold. The 807 sqft unit at $1,610 psf is below the $1,888 median but that median is inflated by larger/newer mix. Add reported defects (discoloured/cracked marble) and a 910m MRT walk, and it lands squarely Neutral.
red_flags: New-launch developer-pricing inflation — bias-adjusted appreciation only 2.2%/yr; recent buyers paid full price, capping near-term upside
910m to the (future) Hougang CRL station — soft walking link, and CRL not operational until ~2030
Reported build defects: discoloured and cracked marble flooring in some units
Smaller 2BR layouts lack store/yard, reducing functional appeal
catalysts: Future Hougang Cross Island Line interchange (~2030) within the broader catchment
Large 1,410-unit project with strong facilities (80m lagoon) and deep resale/rental liquidity
Kovan/Hougang heartland amenity and schools support family demand

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Large project and Kovan location give a steady tenant pool, but 910m to MRT and abundant 2BR supply within the same development create internal rental competition that pressures rates and occupancy.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Underwrite the bias-adjusted ~2-3%/yr, not the 4.9% resale figure or any portal headline CAGR — as a fresh-TOP project the developer premium is already in the price. CRL is a 2030 catalyst but partly anticipated.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: System bias-adjusted rate (2.2%) nudged up slightly for the CRL catalyst; resale-only 4.9% not used to avoid re-introducing new-launch inflation
